name: PT Sumber Global Energy Tbk
summary: PT Sumber Global Energy Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the coal trading business in Indonesia. The company operates through Coal, Nickel, Petroleum coke, Oil palm product, Sand and limestone, Contractor, and Fuel segment. It is also involved in the operation and production of mining for coal freight and trading; sea shipment license; and mining services business license; providing freight and warehousing services, as well as contractor, basic inorganic chemical, and hotel businesses. PT Sumber Global Energy Tbk was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Jakarta Selatan, Indonesia. PT Sumber Global Energy Tbk is a subsidiary of PT Sumbermas Inti Energi.
